blocks.h2: When to Call About Gas Piping

tiles.h3: A Faint Smell Near the Furnace or Stove

tiles.body: Repairs and a pressure test come first.
Branches to removed appliances should be capped.
Old brass connectors should be replaced.

bodies: We track down gas leaks with electronic detectors and by testing fittings one at a time. After the repair, we pressure-test the whole system to confirm it's tight.
In postwar Skokie homes, we often find leaks at old unions and valves, at original appliance connectors and on branches that were abandoned without being capped properly.

blocks.intro: Much of the gas piping in Skokie homes is original black iron from the 1940s to the 1960s.

items.body: The pipe lasts, but joints and valves loosen after decades.
Lines that once fed stoves, dryers or space heaters should be capped and tested.
Bigger furnaces or ranges may need the line checked for size.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Gas Line Repair
blocks.body: A leak at an accessible fitting is quick to fix. A leak inside a wall or under a floor takes longer to reach. Replacing old connectors or a section of pipe adds to the job. We find the leak and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: What should I do if I smell gas?
items.preview: Leave, then call Nicor Gas or 911.
items.answer: Leave the house without touching switches. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside, then call us for the repair.

items.q: Who is responsible for the gas line?
items.preview: The utility up to the meter, you after it.
items.answer: Nicor Gas handles the line up to and including the meter. Piping after the meter is the homeowner's.

items.q: Can you cap old gas lines in my basement?
items.answer: Yes. We cap unused branches properly and pressure-test the system.

items.q: Should I replace old gas connectors?
items.answer: Yes, if they're old uncoated brass. Coated stainless connectors are safer.

items.q: Can you replace an old gas valve?
items.answer: Yes, and we pressure-test the line after.

items.q: How much does gas line repair cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the leak. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how much pipe needs work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
